beats.text: Six signs you're already ahead of most people — even if it doesn't feel like it.
One. You can delay gratification. You'll trade a small reward now for a bigger one later.
Two. You take responsibility instead of hunting for someone to blame.
Three. You're still learning long after school ended. Curiosity never clocked off.
Four. You can sit alone with your own thoughts without reaching for a distraction.
Five. You manage your money — you don't just earn it and watch it vanish.
Six. You do the right thing even when there's no applause for it.
Being ahead is rarely loud. It's a stack of quiet habits most people never bother to build.
